item.title: 2 arrested on multiple drug charges after months-long investigation
item.description: For the last several months, detectives from the Upper Peninsula Substance Enforcement Team (UPSET) have investigated two men believed to be distributing crystal meth, cocaine and fentanyl in Baraga and Houghton counties. On February 5, 2026, detectives at UPSET executed three search warrants, seizing over a quarter pound of crystal meth, an ounce of cocaine, and user amounts on MDMA and fentanyl, all holding a street value of over $15,000.

item.title: Deadline for Homeland Security Funding Approaches
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Time is running out for congressional members to fund the Department of Homeland Security. Members have until the end of the week to move forward with funding. Democrats are still demanding additional reforms for ICE.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell Pleads the Fifth in House Deposition, New Prince Andrew Allegation Over Epstein Emerges
item.description: Convicted Jeffrey Epstein associate, Ghislaine Maxwell, appeared virtually from prison today for a closed-door deposition with the House Oversight Committee. It’s the latest deposition in the bipartisan investigation into Epstein and the federal government’s handling of his case.

item.title: MSU researchers study impacts of state-funded after-school programs as UP participation grows
item.description: Michigan State University researchers are studying how state-funded after-school and summer programs are working across the state, with a focus on access, quality, and impact. New data shows growing participation in the Upper Peninsula after years of limited investment.

item.title: Marquette City Commission approves MDOT grant to allow for Wilson Street overpass
item.description: After years of discussion, a proposed MDOT grant has been passed by the Marquette City Commission that would open the doors for a new overpass on the Iron Ore Heritage Trail.
